instructions: Read the primary source in full. Preserve publication date/status, implementation and source URLs; for an arXiv paper, record its primary and cross-list categories from arXiv. A technically successful full-text fetch is not sufficient when tables, appendices, or other evidence needed for the five slots are missing; continue through the ordered official full-text routes and use the next route only to fill the missing primary evidence. selection_reason: Product Key Memoryで巨大な構造化memoryを疎アクセスし、計算量をほぼ増やさず最大10億parameter規模のcapacityを追加する。Transformer FFNの一部をPKMへ置換した言語モデルで、24層baselineより12層PKMモデルが高品質かつ推論約2倍高速であり、推論時のcapacity-compute trade-offを直接改善するため対象。
title: Large Memory Layers with Product Keys
